answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring a refundable stake before an agent may transact. Like climbers crossing a narrow ridge, each identity must carry real weight: a newcomer locks collateral that peers slash on proof of fraud, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes instead of nothing. Attestation graphs act as an onyx ledger, dark and durable, recording who vouched for whom, so a sybil cluster's shared backers stand out. An ivory list of long-lived agents gates high-value work. The attacker's cost is the stake times every fake, plus the time to build credible history.
